source.content: @isTest private class CoreDatabaseUpsertListObjectBooleanAccesslevelRuntimeTest { @isTest static void upsertRunsInSystemMode() { List<SObject> rows = new List<SObject>{new Account(Name = 'Upsert List Boolean Access One'), new Account(Name = 'Upsert List Boolean Access Two')}; List<Database.UpsertResult> results = Database.upsert(rows, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(results[0].isCreated()); System.assertNotEquals(null, results[0].getId()); System.assert(results[1].isSuccess()); System.assert(results[1].isCreated()); System.assertNotEquals(null, results[1].getId()); } }
